preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the string S for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'WIN' if any(c == '1' for c in S) else 'LOSE'
postconditions.description: If there is at least one face up card ('1') in the string S, Chef can win the game; otherwise, he loses.
